title: Workshop space with open-wheel race chassis, workbench and racing seat rig

Multiple small items, storage containers and boxes are visible across the shelving and desks, but many are partially obscured so individual counts are not provided.

A red tool chest is visible behind the shelving unit toward the rear center-right of the scene.
On the left side of the image a desk with two monitors and the racing-seat simulator occupies the foreground; the simulator faces away from the camera toward the desk/monitors.
A large frosted glass partition or window runs along the rear-right wall behind the chassis, extending from near floor level to ceiling height and providing diffuse light from outside.
